plaza.photo_done: Lake reflections photographed. Show the librarian!
plaza.gather_hint: Approach the lakeside flowerbed before using the field kit.
plaza.gather_done: Flowerbed tended: flowers, twigs and herbs +2 each.
plaza.interact_hint: Approach the librarian, board, bench or library door and press E.
plaza.rested: A quiet lakeside rest restored 35 energy.
plaza.board_text: Observation of the day: the lake's bright specks are sunlight and tree reflections. Photograph the view from the lakeside path, then bring your observation to the librarian.
plaza.quest_text: {name}, would you help make a lake observation page? Photograph the left shore, read the notice board and return. The camera is in slot 4; press Space to use it.
plaza.quest_done: Beautiful reflections! Your observation is complete. Here is a lake lamp and four stones for decorating your dorm.
plaza.thanks: Thank you! You can explore the library, tend flowers, or follow the path into campus.

panel.end_text: You explored Tsing Hua and gathered a campus journey of your own.
panel.close_hint: Esc to close | Click a tab to switch
dialog.complete: Wonderful! This campus memory is now part of your journey.
dialog.guide: Welcome to Tsing Hua, {name}! Start with the gate, administration area, and library.
dialog.librarian: The scattered lights remember every traveler. Bring five of them back to me.
dialog.photographer: The light by Success Lake is perfect. Could you visit the lake, activity area, and sports field?
dialog.professor: A campus is not a collection of buildings, but generations of questions and answers.
dialog.runner: The campus is best at dawn! Run from the sports field to the north woods and dorms.
dialog.engineer: The engineering roads look complex, but the main avenue always leads you through.
dialog.artist: Pixels are tiny, but memories can be immense. I'll help with the club poster.
dialog.roommate: Dorm nights are full of stories. We can put the poster in the common room.
dialog.vendor: Take a break when you're tired. Exploration is not a race.
dialog.researcher: Research takes samples and patience. Come back after gathering fifteen lights.
dialog.alumnus: I remember the old paths through Humanities, Academics, and Engineering. Walk them again for me?
dialog.birdwatcher: Listen—the treetops and lakeside make completely different music.
dialog.club_leader: Club season is close! Ask the artist, engineer, and dorm student to display our posters.
dialog.caretaker: The campus looks after every ordinary day. Finish the other seven journeys, then return.
dialog.student: Everyone gets lost the first time. Open the map and find your position.
